exercises.ru: Здравствуйте. Для нас забронирован номер на имя Дэйвис.
options: No sugar, please. But bring me some cookies.
Hello. You have a reservation for us under the name of Davis.
Miss, excuse me. Do you work on this floor?
Three days. How much will the room cost?
exercises.why: «Здравствуйте. Для нас забронирован номер на имя Дэйвис.» — Hello. You have a reservation for us under the name of Davis. FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 10 (public domain), Вариант диалога 2.
